title: Final Answer Doppler
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the Doppler broadening width, Delta lambda = 0.2 Å.

title: Final Answer Collision
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the collision broadening width, Delta lambda = 0.1 Å.

title: Final Answer Zeeman
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the Zeeman broadening width, Delta lambda = 0.1 Å.

title: Broadening Mechanisms
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss at least two broadening mechanisms, such as Doppler effect and collision broadening.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should use correct units throughout the calculations, ensuring clarity in the final answers.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in calculations, particularly in energy or force equations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the equations, such as constants or coefficients.
